SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT ITEM_NUMBER FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_ITEM WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM < 51 GROUP BY ITEM_NUMBER
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSDE' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ITEM_NUMBER AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, UOM_CODE AS UNIT_MEASURE, CATEGORY_CODE AS CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_TEXT, ATTRIBUTE1 AS ATTR_1, ATTRIBUTE2 AS ATTR_2, ATTRIBUTE3 AS ATTR_3, ATTRIBUTE4 AS ATTR_4, ATTRIBUTE5 AS ATTR_5, CREATION_DATE AS CREATE_DATE, IF_TYPE AS STATUS FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_ITEM WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ITEM_NUMBER = '$G_RS.ITEM_NUMBER$'
UPDATE UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_ITEM SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND ITEM_NUMBER = '$G_RS.ITEM_NUMBER$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
